witness.quote: No person shall stand or park a vehicle in a roadway other than parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.
witness.reason: An identifiable road edge and parallel-parking intent support an active roadway parking realization.
required_context: Do not impose an angular tolerance, minimum duration or numerical curb-distance requirement.
Establish responsible person, vehicle identity, parking purpose, actual activity and applicable Chapter provisions.
Establish roadway and shoulder boundaries, edge geometry, adequate maneuvering space, parking footprint and lawful traffic direction.
Preserve municipal jurisdiction, unresolved definition applicability and the Chapter-wide exception; angle-parking permission is only an unverified possible Chapter exception.
Provide identifiable edge, sufficient maneuvering space, lawful traffic direction, roadway classification and shoulder exclusion.
Retain responsible-person and vehicle identity, position, heading, halt purpose and actual passenger or merchandise activity.
witness.subject_reason: This available driver can be the person who places and leaves the motor vehicle in the observed parking position.
